report.title: Schematic Review Report
report.subtitle: {project} / {board} / {schematic} / {date}
report.disclaimer: This report does not replace manual review or EDA DRC.
report.empty: No formal findings in this review.
report.empty.hint: Manual review of coverage and limitations is still recommended.
report.review.localStorageFailed: Review marks cannot be saved in this environment. Use Export instead.
report.screenshot.otherPage: Screenshot unavailable (component on another page; rerun with --map-pages)
report.screenshot.caption: Red boxes: {designators}
R001.title: Single-pin net: {net}
R001.impact: A single-pin net often means a missing connection, dangling pin, or typo.
R001.suggestion: Confirm the intended connection; test points and antennas may be exempt.
R002.title: Floating component pin: {designator}.{pin}
R002.observation: Pin {pin} ({pinName}) of {designator} is not connected to any net.
R002.impact: Floating inputs can cause indeterminate levels, false triggers, or extra current.
R002.suggestion: Confirm whether it is intentionally unconnected; otherwise add a pull-up/down or net.
R003.title: Duplicate designator: {designator}
R003.observation: Designator {designator} is used by multiple components: {uids}.
R003.impact: Duplicate designators confuse BOM, assembly, and debugging.
R003.suggestion: Assign unique designators; use U1A/U1B or a shared Group ID for multi-part devices.
R004.title: Net has no pins: {net}
R004.observation: Net {net} exists in design rules but has no component pins.
R004.impact: It may be an obsolete net or a typo.
R004.suggestion: Remove the unused net or fix the connection.
R005.title: DRC dangling net: {net}
R005.observation: EDA DRC reports a dangling connection on net {net}.
R005.impact: Dangling nets can cause routing failures or incomplete connectivity.
R005.suggestion: Inspect the net and its connection points in EDA.
R006.title: Floating power/ground pin: {designator}.{pin}
R006.observation: Power/ground pin {pin} ({pinName}) of {designator} is not connected.
R006.impact: The device may not power up or may behave unpredictably.
R006.suggestion: Connect the correct power/ground net; verify NC against the datasheet.
R007.title: Power net has no source: {net}
R007.observation: No connector, regulator, battery, or switch source was found for power net {net}.
R007.impact: The rail may never receive power.
R007.suggestion: Confirm the source or add a power entry/regulator circuit.
R008.title: Missing IC decoupling: {designator} / {net}
R008.observation: No decoupling capacitor was found between power net {net} and ground for {designator}.
R008.impact: Missing decoupling can cause noise, reset issues, or instability.
R008.suggestion: Add a 100nF capacitor near the power pin, plus bulk capacitance if needed.
R009.title: Missing I2C pull-up: {net}
R009.observation: No pull-up resistor to a power rail was found on I2C net {net}.
R009.impact: Open-drain I2C may fail to pull high, causing communication failure.
R009.suggestion: Add 2.2k–10k pull-ups based on bus voltage and speed.
R010.title: Missing reset pull-up: {designator}.{pin}
R010.observation: Reset pin {designator}.{pin} is connected but has no pull-up/down resistor.
R010.impact: Reset level may be indeterminate, causing boot issues.
R010.suggestion: Add a reset pull-up/down and capacitor, and verify power-up timing.
R011.title: BOOT pin floating: {designator}.{pin}
R011.impact: Boot mode is indeterminate and may select the wrong medium.
R011.suggestion: Tie BOOT to the level required by the device.
R012.title: Missing crystal load capacitors: {designator}
R012.observation: No load capacitors to ground were found on crystal {designator}.
R012.impact: The crystal may not start or may run off-frequency.
R012.suggestion: Add load capacitors per the crystal datasheet.
R013.title: Missing LED current-limiting resistor: {designator}
R013.observation: No series current-limiting resistor was found on either side of LED {designator}.
R013.impact: The LED or driving pin may be damaged by overcurrent.
R013.suggestion: Add a series resistor in the LED path.
R014.title: Incomplete differential pair: {net}
R014.observation: Differential pair {net} has only one side, or the counterpart net is missing.
R014.impact: Signal integrity is degraded and the interface may not work.
R014.suggestion: Complete the pair and add termination as required.
R015.title: Floating connector power/ground pin: {designator}.{pin}
R015.observation: Power/ground pin {pin} ({pinName}) of connector {designator} is not connected.
R015.impact: Power or return path through the connector may be incomplete.
R016.title: Missing or placeholder value: {designator}
R016.observation: Value of {designator} is empty or a placeholder ({value}).
R016.impact: BOM and assembly information is incomplete.
R016.suggestion: Enter the real value or part number; mark DNP explicitly if applicable.
R017.title: Missing footprint: {designator}
R017.observation: {designator} is marked for PCB conversion but has no footprint.
R017.impact: PCB or assembly files cannot be generated.
R018.title: Unusual BOM/PCB flags: {designator}
R018.observation: Add into BOM / Convert to PCB flags of {designator} are inconsistent.
R018.suggestion: Confirm whether the part belongs in BOM and PCB.
R019.title: Missing supplier part: {designator}
R019.observation: {designator} is in BOM but has no supplier part number.
R019.impact: Procurement and assembly may be blocked.
R019.suggestion: Add a supplier part number or mark it as non-purchased.
R020.title: Similar net names: {netA} / {netB}
R020.observation: Net names {netA} and {netB} differ by very few characters.
R020.impact: Likely a typo that leaves nets unintentionally separated.
R020.suggestion: Confirm whether they should be one net and unify the name.
R023.title: Missing power input protection: {net}
R023.observation: No fuse, TVS, or reverse-polarity protection was found on input net {net}.
R023.impact: Surges or reverse polarity may damage downstream circuitry.
R023.suggestion: Evaluate and add input protection for the product environment.
R025.title: No test point on key rail: {net}
R025.observation: No test point was found on power net {net}.
R025.impact: Debugging and production test are less convenient.
R025.suggestion: Add a test point on the key rail.
R026.title: BOM/netlist mismatch: {detail}
R026.impact: BOM and design disagree, affecting procurement and assembly.
R026.suggestion: Reconcile the BOM with the schematic.
R027.title: Unused op-amp channel input floating: {designator}
R027.observation: An unused channel of op-amp {designator} has floating inputs.
R027.impact: Floating inputs may oscillate or draw extra current.
R027.suggestion: Tie unused channels as followers or to fixed levels.
R028.title: Unused logic gate input floating: {designator}.{pin}
R028.observation: Input pin {pin} of logic device {designator} is floating.
R028.impact: Floating CMOS inputs can cause indeterminate levels and extra current.
R028.suggestion: Tie unused inputs to a fixed level or to a used input.
R029.title: Power/ground net conflict: {net}
R029.observation: Net {net} has both power and ground attributes, or two different rails are shorted.
R029.impact: May cause a power short, device damage, or a board that will not power up.
R029.suggestion: Inspect the net and any 0Ω/jumper configuration immediately.
R030.title: MOSFET gate pull-down missing: {designator}.{pin}
R030.observation: Gate {pin} of MOSFET {designator} is connected, but no pull-down to source/ground was found.
R030.impact: Gate level may be indeterminate at power-up or when the driver is high-Z, causing false turn-on.
R030.suggestion: Add a 10k–100k pull-down between gate and source as required by the driver.
R031.title: BJT base resistor missing: {designator}.{pin}
R031.observation: No series base resistor was found on base {pin} of transistor {designator}.
R031.impact: Base current may be excessive and damage the transistor or driving pin.
R031.suggestion: Add a base resistor sized for the required Ib and drive voltage.
R032.title: Relay coil flyback diode missing: {designator}
R032.observation: No reverse flyback diode was found across the coil of relay {designator}.
R032.impact: Coil turn-off flyback may damage the driver transistor.
R032.suggestion: Add a reverse diode across the coil, plus RC/zener if needed.
R033.title: Regulator feedback divider incomplete: {designator}.{pin}
R033.observation: No complete feedback divider was found on FB pin {pin} of regulator {designator}.
R033.impact: Output voltage may be wrong, or the loop may run away if FB floats.
R033.suggestion: Connect the upper/lower feedback resistors per the datasheet and verify Vout.
R034.title: Regulator enable pin floating: {designator}.{pin}
R034.observation: Enable pin {pin} of regulator {designator} is not connected.
R034.impact: Enable level is indeterminate; the supply may not start or may toggle randomly.
R034.suggestion: Tie EN to input, logic control, or a fixed level per the datasheet.
R035.title: Two-pin device shorted: {designator}
R035.observation: Both pins of {designator} are connected to net {net}.
R035.impact: The device is shorted and may lose function or draw abnormal current.
R035.suggestion: Check the connection; mark 0Ω/jumper parts explicitly if intentional.
Q.unknown: The netlist cannot prove the design intent of this connection.
R036.title: Regulator output capacitor missing: {designator}
R036.observation: No output capacitor was found between output net {net} and ground for regulator {designator}.
R036.impact: The output may oscillate or have poor transient response.
R036.suggestion: Add the output capacitor (and ESR) required by the datasheet.
R037.title: LED polarity may be reversed: {designator}
R037.observation: Anode of LED {designator} is connected to ground and cathode to {net}.
R037.impact: The LED may be reverse-biased and not light, or conduct in the wrong direction.
R037.suggestion: Verify the A/K symbol and footprint polarity, then fix the connection.
R038.title: Polarized capacitor may be reversed: {designator}
R038.observation: The positive terminal of polarized capacitor {designator} is on ground, or the negative terminal is on a power rail.
R038.impact: A reversed electrolytic capacitor may vent, leak, or be damaged.
R038.suggestion: Verify polarity marks and footprint orientation, then fix the connection.
R039.title: Relay flyback diode orientation wrong: {designator}
R039.observation: The flyback diode on relay {designator} has its anode on the power side.
R039.impact: The flyback path is invalid and coil turn-off may damage the driver.
R039.suggestion: Connect diode cathode to the coil power side and anode to the driver side.
